_comment: Generic placement (Phase 3 plan section 3.6, Sprint 23). A parent picks a starting grade (K = 0 ... 6) when a profile is made; each skill of a listed zone starts with that zone's BKT prior instead of its bkt_defaults.json prior, and the placement quest starts from the grade's probes. A grade with no row uses the highest row below it (grades 4-6 use grade 3). Values are the plan's starting points, not fitted: changing them needs Spiro's sign-off (BKT defaults are on the ask list). Charlie keeps his Star seed (Placement.SEED_SETS).
